summary: A large, U-shaped building characterized by striking horizontal bands of brick, wood, and white blocks. It features a dark red gable roof with stepped ends, vertical white pillars for articulation, and an inner courtyard.
rebuild_hints: Lay out a U-shaped foundation with a central courtyard.
Build walls with alternating horizontal layers: brick, white block, wood, white block, brick.
Place vertical white pillars on the exterior walls to break up the horizontal lines.
Construct a gable roof using dark red blocks, creating stepped designs on the gable ends facing the front and back.
uncertainties: Exact material of the white blocks (could be quartz, concrete, or wool).
Interior structure, layout, and exact floor heights are completely hidden.
The exact purpose or final design of the low, broken white perimeter wall.
